cases.name: Amy Lynette Clemons
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Amy was first and foremost a mother. Amy’s daughters, Haley and Chloe were her world, her joy and she was dedicated to them. Her happiest days were when each of her daughters were born. They went on vacations together to Disney World, Pensacola Beach, visited family in Alabama and Florida.

Amy was a very energetic, passionate person and was described by many as fearless. She was very passionate about animals and it seemed like she was trying to rescue them all, horses, chickens, sheep,  dogs and her beloved Standard Poodles.  Amy surrounded herself with animals of all kinds. She was a member of many different animal rescue groups and organizations.

Amy’s life was cut short by a senseless act of violence, and her death serves as a reminder of the devastating impact of domestic abuse. Many people didn’t know about this part of her life, it seems she was trying to protect us all from the harsh, painful truth."
